purpose: External acquired-data layer (injuries, rosters, depth charts, advanced metrics, power ratings). Feeds accuracy; does not itself change any frozen model.

schema_per_pull.provenance_class: one of OFFICIAL_LEAGUE | REPUTABLE_OUTLET | AGGREGATOR | WEBSEARCH_MULTI_SOURCE
schema_per_pull.confidence: HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW — LOW/unsourced items are flagged, never fed to a model
schema_per_pull.as_of: injury/lineup data is time-sensitive; every pull is timestamped and treated as as-of

integration_policy.V13_MLB: currently uses team season RF/RA + starter logs; it is lineup/bullpen-BLIND. Injury data is surfaced as a reconciliation/stale-input flag now; consuming it inside the model would be a NEW hashed V13 identity (R3), proposed to the owner, not a silent edit.
integration_policy.WNBA_log5: records/Massey are injury+rest-BLIND. Injury data is used to explain market-vs-rating divergences and flag which games the rating cannot be trusted on.
integration_policy.grading: acquired data never auto-enters a forecast or ledger; it improves inputs, not outcomes.

firewall: data/feeds/wnba and all WNBA artifacts stay isolated from the MLB engine/registries/gate.
sources_registry: populated by the sources-scout agent (which authoritative feeds are reachable via WebSearch/WebFetch) on workflow completion.
